title: Telemetry Sanitized Replayer and Signal Attenuation Tooling
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Adds a sandboxed telemetry replayer that sanitizes sensitive fields and a signal-attenuation config to reduce noise during oncall replays; CLI and playbook suggestions included.
commits: init: add sanitized replayer CLI and core replay engine
feat: implement attenuation weight scheduler and JSON redaction rules
test: add unit tests for redaction and attenuation heuristics

ci: add sandbox e2e job and flake tolerance
description: Motivation: Oncall sessions often need deterministic replays of a narrow telemetry window but doing so risks leaking secrets and overwhelms responders with noisy signals. This PR adds a lightweight, local replay CLI that produces sandboxed, sanitized replay bundles and a signal attenuation layer to reduce noise and surface probable root signals without changing production telemetry. Key points: 1) sanitized replayer CLI (cmd/replay) that consumes a sampled bundle and replays events into a local sandbox process, applying redaction rules and rate attenuation; 2) redactor module with configurable field filters, regex scrubbing, canonicalization hooks and a safety whitelist to prevent accidental exposure of PII/KV payloads; 3) attenuation scheduler that downweights repetitive noisy signals (heartbeats, verbose debug logs) using a tunable decay and per-source weights; 4) playbook hinter that emits suggested runbook steps based on the top-attenuated signals detected; 5) sandbox manifest and e2e harness that runs the replay in an isolated container for postmortem workflows. Checklist: - [x] core replay engine and CLI - [x] redaction schema and safety whitelist - [x] attenuation heuristics + config - [x] docs and usage guide - [x] unit tests for redaction/attenuation - [x] sandbox e2e - [x] security review signoff Design notes: The redactor applies three passes (schema strip, regex scrub, canonical token masking). Attenuation is a probabilistic decayer that assigns a priority score per signal; signals below threshold are throttled in replay but kept in the bundle for auditability. The CLI exposes --attenuation-profile, --whitelist, --dry-run, and --sanitized-output flags. Commits summary: see commits field. Files touched: high-level list provided; changes are intentionally modular to keep runtime surface small. Testing: Added unit tests covering corner cases for nested JSON redaction and attenuation with synthetic traces. Added e2e sandbox that spins a containerized mock service and verifies end-to-end that sanitized replays do not leak raw tokens and that attenuation reduces noise by >=60% on synthetic traces. Maya: "Added examples and a validation step that fails fast if whitelist would redact all identifiers in a bundle." Kai: "CI e2e flaked once for docker startup timeout; add retry." Flaky test tolerance added in scripts/ci/sandbox-e2e.yml and tests adjusted to wait-for-ready; rerun completed and all checks passed (unit, linters, sandbox-e2e). Security review: security@sre signed off on redaction heuristics and whitelist fallback. Merge: Squash-merged to main after approvals (Amit, Jules). Notes for operators: attenuation profiles live in incidents/attenuation_profiles.yaml; default profile tuned for oncall short-replays. Usage example: "replay bundle.jsonl --sanitized-output sanitized.jsonl --attenuation-profile quick-oncall". Rollout plan: feature gated behind incident-bot feature flag "replay.sanitized.v1"; soft launch to internal SRE for two weeks, then enable by request for customers.
